outlook.statement: Focus shifting from reach to productivity, from transaction volume to service depth, and from network scale alone to stronger platform economics; emphasis on higher-margin BFSI and non-cash services (insurance, lending, account opening, deposits, mutual funds, NPA recovery), technology-enabled delivery (BharatEasy, Vortex Engineering, Perfo®), financial discipline, cash flow generation, debt-free balance sheet, selective capital allocation, responsible and profitable growth.

Vortex Engineering plans to launch multiple new products to reimagine customer interaction with ATMs and bank branches, combining customer-centric design, flexible banking-automation architecture, intelligent monitoring, and service-rich interfaces.

Priorities are to improve yield per Kendra, expand higher-margin BFSI and non-cash services, strengthen partner integrations, scale BharatEasy as a phygital extension, leverage Vortex for banking automation and technology-led opportunities, maintain disciplined cash flow, capital allocation and governance, and evaluate selective strategic adjacencies subject to appropriate approvals and disclosure readiness.
Focus on margin expansion, cash flow generation, working capital discipline, better revenue quality, high-margin BFSI services, recurring technology income, and responsible capital allocation.
Strengthen high-margin BFSI, insurance and lending services
Increase yield per Kendra through better product depth, customer conversion and franchisee training
Improve revenue quality by balancing transaction-led, commission-led, product-led and recurring revenue streams
Scale BharatEasy as a digital extension of the trusted physical network
Leverage Vortex Engineering to expand banking automation, AMC, software and ATM infrastructure opportunities
Maintain cash flow discipline, capital-light expansion and debt-free financial strength

Technology agenda extended beyond individual applications into one architecture with shared controls and shared visibility connecting BharatEasy, Data and analytics, partner integrations, operating systems, Vortex and Perfo®.

Governed AI agenda in three tiers: Operational (dashboards, automated alerts, ticket routing, service monitoring, rule-based process support), In development (customer assistance, field productivity, anomaly detection, service recommendations, predictive maintenance), Exploratory (personalised service discovery, conversational interfaces, advanced decision support, broader generative-AI applications).
Platform should scale only as fast as its reliability and governance can support.

Transition from reach-led scale towards higher-margin services, digital integration, technology-led infrastructure and responsible growth with focus on profitable scale and disciplined platform economics
Expanding partner-led model across insurance, lending, banking services, ATM and Vortex-enabled banking automation
Growing technology and data infrastructure with modular architecture, product roadmaps, upgrades, R&D, and selective AI investment
Expanding Vortex products and AMC with stage-gated product development, demand visibility, service readiness and cash discipline

Focus on improving yield per Kendra, higher-margin services (account opening, insurance, lending, mutual funds, NPA recovery), recurring Vortex income (AMC, software, Perfo®), BharatEasy O2O integration, and stage-gated clean-energy adjacency (solar inverter, lithium-ion battery) with strict certification, pilot, channel, service and lifecycle conditions.

Capital allocation prioritised towards technology/platform systems, Vortex Engineering (AMC, software, infrastructure), BharatEasy O2O layer, franchisee/field enablement, partner integration, balance sheet conservation, and approved adjacencies meeting return/risk/governance thresholds.
Deepen Kendra-level service productivity through higher-margin BFSI and non-cash services
Improve yield per outlet through better product depth, customer conversion and field training
Selectively expand ATM-enabled infrastructure where access gaps and returns justify deployment
Scale Vortex through ATM manufacturing, AMC, Perfo® and banking automation opportunities
Strengthen BharatEasy as the digital extension of the physical Kendra network
Reinforce technical support, service uptime, field enablement and partner integration across the platform
Deepen higher-value BFSI and non-cash services while preserving customer suitability and responsible conduct
Improve service activation and repeat usage across existing Kendra network rather than relying only on outlet growth
Strengthen district-level franchisee support, training, monitoring and issue resolution
Use BharatEasy as digital extension of physical trust network and simplify O2O customer journeys
Expand partner integrations and ensure consistent service-level governance
Maintain strong privacy, cyber security, grievance and ethical-conduct outcomes
Continue serving Tier IV-VI and priority geographies through commercially sustainable access points

The next phase is not about reach alone; it is about improving the value created through that reach for customers, franchisees, partners, communities and shareholders. The Company's strategic response is to combine Kendra-led access with digital journeys, regulated partner products, Vortex-led infrastructure and stronger operating assurance to progressively improve yield and recurring income.

The industry is moving towards integrated service ecosystems rather than single-product channels. Institutions need lower-cost distribution, customers need trust and assistance, and operators need stronger visibility over fulfilment and service quality.

Prioritise profitable service activation and yield per Kendra over network expansion; increase recurring software, AMC and service income within ATM technology portfolio; launch new Vortex products for service-rich, digitally integrated ATM/branch interface; use data/analytics to improve partner performance, customer relevance, fraud monitoring and issue resolution; maintain debt-free discipline while investing selectively in technology, product capability and working capital; strengthen Master Franchisee and field-team accountability through transparent dashboards and service standards; deepen customer protection, privacy, cyber resilience and responsible sales.

The Board remains optimistic about the Company's growth prospects, supported by continued expansion of its service portfolio, entry into new business verticals including apparel retail, scaling up of high-margin financial services, and the integration and growth of Vortex Engineering's ATM manufacturing and banking technology business.
Ambitious goal for the end of this fiscal year is to achieve complete 100% district coverage through master franchise network.
Vortex is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing demand for secure, energy-efficient, and next-generation ATM solutions.

Vortex is well-positioned to accelerate its growth trajectory by expanding its market share, strengthening its product portfolio, and capitalizing on the increasing demand for next-generation self-service banking and digital transaction solutions across India.

The Company actively monitors advancements in technology and regularly evaluates opportunities for adoption and integration. Continuous efforts are made to upgrade systems and processes in line with emerging technological trends.
Focus on quality enhancement and service excellence by embracing relevant technological improvements to drive operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Prioritising compliance with regulations to avoid legal pitfalls, fines, and reputational harm, while gaining competitive edge in heavily regulated industry through proactive measures demonstrating commitment to integrity and responsible operations.

Digital transformation offers gateway to unlocking new customer segments, optimising operations, and driving innovation through cutting-edge technologies; harnessing data analytics and digital platforms to maintain agility, make informed decisions, and establish competitive edge.

Achieving peak franchisee performance is a strategic opportunity resulting in heightened revenue generation, improved customer satisfaction, and broader market penetration; prioritising comprehensive training, robust support, and sustained motivation for franchisees to harness collective performance across network of over 22,900 Kendras.

Embracing sustainable practices and eco-friendly products to align with evolving customer and stakeholder expectations, positioning as industry leaders; integrating energy efficiencies, increasing renewable energy use (currently 13% from solar), expanding through power purchase agreements, adopting cleaner technologies, green IT practices, and sustainable procurement via Green Procurement Policy prioritizing EPEAT-certified products.

Intersection of financial, digital, and social inclusion offers significant opportunity to reach underserved markets, expand customer base, and stimulate revenue growth by delivering accessible financial services, leveraging digital technologies, and supporting social programs, aligning with governmental priorities.

Committed to using the most environmentally friendly practices to combat climate change, minimising environmental impact, and ensuring goods and services are offered in the most environmentally responsible way possible. Working towards lowering carbon footprint and improving health safety at corporate headquarters and all Next-Gen Vakrangee Kendras.

Business strategy mapped with sustainability initiatives along with United Nation's Sustainable Development Goals. Re-affirmed commitment towards sustainability by opting for 'Green Power' at Corporate Headquarters.
